title: Search, filters, sorting and scrolling keep working in bulk mode
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active parts: part A and part C in category A, and part B in category B, so the category A filter leaves part B out.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists them, and descriptions that run A to Z in the order part A, part B, part C.
  • Make sure the test location has more than 30 active parts, so the list loads more rows as you scroll.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  4. Pick category A in the Category filter.
  5. Pick All categories in the Category filter.
  6. Click the Description column heading.
  7. Click the Description column heading again.
  8. Clear the Search box.
  9. Scroll the list to the bottom.
  10. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • The search works with the bar still on screen: parts A, B and C are listed, each with a checkbox.

Step 4:

  • The filter works: only parts A and C are listed.

Step 5:

  • All three are listed again.

Step 6:

  • The rows are ordered by Description: part A, part B, part C, or the other way round.

Step 7:

  • The order reverses.

Step 8:

  • The list shows the location's other active parts too, each with a checkbox.

Step 9:

  • More rows load as you scroll (30 at a time), each with a checkbox, and the bar stays on screen.

Step 10:

  • Bulk mode ends and no part changed status.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R10: “Search, the filter bar, sorting and paging keep working while the mode is on, as they do in Cycle count.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
